name: str_equal_ci
purpose: Case-insensitive 7-bit (c & 0x7f, upper-cased) comparison of two NUL-terminated strings; compares a pair, then loops while either string still has characters; 1 equal, 0 different.
notes: Ghidra labels it CMDS_bf80 (same address in CMDS).

name: is_talk_through_tile
purpose: 1 when the map tile at (y, x) is one the party talks across: 0x29, 0x94..0x9c, 0xa5, 0xae, 0xba, 0xbb, 0xbe, 0xca, 0xcb; else 0.

name: ask_dost_thou_pay
purpose: Prints "Dost thou pay? " (0x9052) and waits for Y (prints "Yes", returns 0) or N ("No", returns 1).

name: talk_to_shopkeeper
purpose: Shopkeeper service for dialogue index 0x81..0x88. On horseback (transport 0x12/0x13) except shop type 2: "GET THAT HORSE OUT OF HERE!" (0x9072). Else member = g_active_member or first conscious (g_dx); 0xb116 = type = dialogue-0x81; 0xb114 = column of g_location in g_shop_towns[type] (0..15); 0xaafc/0xaafe = shop / shopkeeper name pointers from g_shop_name_ptrs / g_shopkeeper_name_ptrs; dispatch: 0 SHOPPES b542, 1 SHOPPES2 e84c, 2 SHOPPES aa4e, 3 SHOPPES2 ec9c, 4 SHOPPES a9ee, 5 SHOPPES a732, 6 SHOPPES b788, 7 SHOPPES3 ea94 (member passed).

0xb114.name: g_shop_slot
0xb114.meaning: column in the shop tables for this town

notes: SHOPPES b788 stub currently takes no member argument.

name: guard_challenge
purpose: Guard with dialogue 0xff. Location 0x12 (Blackthorn's palace): with g_status_icon 0x1d the password is asked (14 chars, truncated to 4) and compared with "IMPE" at 0x4a9a: "Pass, friend." -> 0, else 1. Location 5 (Minoc): "Thou wilt give half thy gold to charity?" -> refuse 1, else gold /= 2. Elsewhere a tribute of 10 gp per non-dead member ("A guard demands a N gp tribute to Blackthorn!"): refuse or insufficient gold -> 1, else paid. Status window redrawn, returns 0 (1 = arrest).

name: talk_to_npc
purpose: Conversation entry (also TOWN handle_npc_contact). Newline; 0xbcdc = npc. AI type of the current schedule entry 4 -> set to 1; else a guard tile (slot tile 0x70) with an even schedule entry or dialogue 0: "The guard offers no response." Dialogue 0: "No response!"; < 0x80: run_conversation; 0xfd: "Don't hurt me! Please go away!"; 0xfe: TOWN begone_vermin (no argument pushed in the original); 0xff: returns guard_challenge; shopkeeper when the stored entry is odd and schedule_index_for_hour(g_hour) is odd (working hours) else "A merchant says: Come see me at ... when it's open!". Returns 0 otherwise.

0xbcdc.name: g_talk_npc
0xbcdc.meaning: index of the NPC being talked to

0x5f5e.name: g_npc_states
0x5f5e.meaning: NPC state: +0xa dialogue index, +0xc monster slot, +0xe schedule entry

name: cmd_talk
purpose: Talk command in settlements (ROOT 'T'). Direction (0 -> 0); target one cell away, two when the first is empty and a talk-through tile. No object: "Nobody's here!"; otherwise npc = find_npc_by_slot(g_dx); map tile 0x9d (mirror): "No response!"; 0xab (sleeping): string 0x91e8; else returns talk_to_npc(npc) (non-zero = arrest -> ROOT returns 2).

name: emit_newline
purpose: interpret_byte(0x8d): queues a newline.

name: emit_quote
purpose: interpret_byte(0xa2): queues a double quote (collapsed when the previous char was one).

name: flush_pending_text
purpose: Prints the pending word buffer: font 1 when bit 7 is clear else font 0, char & 0x7f; skips a space at column 0 and a newline while 0x4af3 >= 15 (resets it); other chars record the cursor column. Clears the length and selects font 0.

0x4af3.meaning: cursor column at the last printed char; >= 15 suppresses the next newline

name: queue_char
purpose: Appends ch to the pending buffer (when it is full, flushes without appending). A newline 0x8a or space 0xa0 ends the word: newline first when cursor column + length > 17, then flush.

0xbce4.meaning: pending output word (bit 7 clear = rune font)

name: pay_gold_price
purpose: Price = 100*d0 + 10*d1 + d2 - 0x14d0 from the three digit bytes (ASCII|0x80) at 0xbce0. Not enough gold: pending text dropped, "Thou hast not enough gold." + 0x9344, opcode cleared, returns interest_loop(). Else gold -= price, status redrawn; a beggar (NPC slot tile group 0x6c) with g_turn_counter > 99: counter = 0, karma +1 (+2 more when gold hits 0). Returns 0.

name: give_item

name: join_party
purpose: Opcode 0x84. Party full (6): read key, "Thou hast no room for me in thy party! Seek me again if one of thy members leaves." -> 0. Else the first 3 letters of section 0 (NPC name) are compared (str_equal_ci) with party records 15..1: match -> record +0x1f = 0, record swapped with record g_party_count, count++, TOWN set_npc_killed + remove_npc, status redrawn, pending text flushed -> 1. No match: quote + newline queued, "System Error - No Match!" -> 1. Script pointer restored.

purpose: For k = 0..: seek_keyword(k) (0 -> return 0); str_find_ci(input, keyword) at index 0 or after a space -> 0xbcf6 = k, return 1.

name: say_bye
purpose: Quote, section 4; if it did not end the conversation: quote, newline. Returns 1.

name: handle_builtin_keyword
purpose: idx 0 NAME: "My name is " + section 0; 1-2 JOB: quote + section 3; both: 1 if the section ended the conversation else quote, 2 newlines, 0. 3-4 BYE: say_bye. While 0x4af2 (answering a question) these return 2. idx >= 5 (insults): "With language like that, how did thy mother ever get along with thee?", quote, newlines, 28-tick pause / key, keyboard flushed, 0.

0x4af2.meaning: 0xff while the player answers a label question (NAME/JOB/BYE not handled)

name: interest_loop
purpose: Loop: 0x4af2 = 0; "Your interest? "; empty -> 0x941a + say_bye. Two newlines; built-in keywords (34 at 0x4aa8, str_find_ci at a word start): handled (0) -> loop, 1 -> return 1, 2 -> continue; then find_npc_keyword: found -> quote + run_section(2k+6) (1 -> return 1) else "I cannot help thee with that."; quote + 2 newlines; loop.

name: find_label_keyword
purpose: Finds the label, skips its question and default answer, then tests each keyword of the label's list against the input (word start); 1 with the pointer on the keyword, 0 when the list ends (0x90).

name: ask_question_at_label
purpose: Quote + run_label_text (1 -> 1). Quote; repeat: newlines, 0x4af2 = 0xff, "You respond: ", read until non-empty ("What didst thou say?"). Newlines; built-in keywords: 0 -> re-ask the question, 1 -> 1. Then find_label_keyword: answer after the keyword (run_next_string) or the default answer (run_label_default_answer); 0 -> quote, newlines, return interest_loop(); else 1.

Other: clear. Returns 0 unless a routine ended the conversation.

purpose: Opcode 0x88: quote, flush, "What is thy name?" "You respond: ", read; pending op cleared. Empty -> "If you say so..."; else the first 4 letters of every party member's name are searched in the input (word start): found -> set_npc_met, "A pleasure!"; none -> "If you say so...".

name: interpret_byte
purpose: Dialogue byte interpreter (1 = end). Pending opcode -> interpret_opcode_arg. Repeated 0xa2 dropped. 0x89 karma+1; 0x8a karma-1; 0x8b TOWN raise_alarm; 0x81 Avatar name; 0x82 end; 0x83 pause 28 ticks/key; 0x84 join_party; 0x85/0x86/0x8c/0xfe arm the opcode; 0x87 skip_string_and_run (1 -> 1, else the script pointer is restored to after the 0x87); 0x88 ask_avatar_name; 0x8e toggle font mask; 0x8f wait key; 0x91..0x9f label -> ask_question_at_label; 0xff flush + interest_loop. Text: b < 0x81 -> space + compressed word g_tlk_word_ptrs[b] (chars | 0x80; empty -> raw byte) and need-space flag; else (b|0x80, 0x8d -> 0x8a) & font mask, preceded by a space when flagged; last char recorded.

0x4aee.name: g_talk_pending_op
0x4aee.meaning: opcode waiting for argument bytes: 0x85 pay, 0x86 give, 0x8c if-met, 0xfe karma gate; 0 none

0x4aef.name: g_talk_pending_argc
0x4aef.meaning: argument bytes collected (the code also touches it as a u16 together with 0x4af0)

0x4af0.name: g_talk_font_mask
0x4af0.meaning: 0xff normal, 0x7f rune font (toggled by opcode 0x8e; DATA.OVL initial 0xff)

0x4af4.name: g_talk_last_char
0x4af4.meaning: last text byte emitted (a repeated 0xa2 quote is dropped)

0x4af5.name: g_talk_need_space
0x4af5.meaning: set after a compressed word; next literal char gets a leading space

notes: Ghidra's trailing `bcde = uVar1` is an artifact; only the 0x87 case saves/restores the pointer (listing cf3c..cf4c).

name: greet_npc
purpose: "You see " + section 1 (1 -> 1); 2 newlines; met -> quote + section 2 (greeting); not met -> reseed, 50%: "I am called " + section 0, else return 0. Section ended -> 1; else quote, 2 newlines, 0.

name: shadowlord_steals_item
purpose: When g_save_unk_3b2 == 0 (Shadowlord 0 present): "Something was stolen!", tone sweep, reseed. No keys/gems/torches: first non-zero of inventory[47..0], potions[7..0], scrolls[7..0] loses 1; none -> gold -= 1..15, status redrawn. Else a random non-zero one of keys/gems/torches loses 1.

name: run_conversation
purpose: Loads the .TLK header (0x200 bytes, file name 0x4aa0[(location-1)/8]) into g_ool_buffer, finds the {npc, offset} entry for talk_idx (count at 0xb21e, pairs from 0xb220), loads its 1 KB; greet_npc, interest_loop, say_bye (each skipped once one ends the conversation); then shadowlord_steals_item.
